text_content: bfp judo team pins pussl medals: a four-win haul from manila! davao city, philippines personnel from region 11 representing the bureau of fire protection continue to showcase its excellence beyond the call of duty, this time achieving significant success on the national mat. our dedicated fire personnel secured a total of four medals at the prestigious philippine uniformed services sports league (pussl) 2025 judo tournament, held recently at the rizal memorial complex in malate, manila. the pussl, organized by the philippine sports commission (psc) in coordination with the philippine judo federation, pits the country's finest uniformed personnel against each other in various sports, demanding peak discipline and strength. the bfp team rose to the occasion, displaying the technical skill and mental fortitude of true martial artists. the following fire officers proudly brought home the medals representing not only for region 11 but the whole bureau as well: the medalists were: sfo2 jennifer o malang bronze, 70kg womens category, regional headquarters 11 fo1 bless anne g melecio silver, 52kg womens category, panabo fire station fo3 edyson e castaneros silver, 81kg mens category, cabidianan fire station fo3 john paul l tanud-tanud bronze, 73kg mens category, maragusan fire station these victories are a testament to the comprehensive training and warrior spirit embedded in the bfp service. the entire bfp region 11 under the leadership of fcsupt junito f maslang, dsc, bfp 11 regional director and personnel extend our warmest congratulations to our judo champions! their performance is a source of immense pride and an inspiration to every member of the bureau. bfp judo team pins pussl medals: a four-win haul from manila!
